goal: Audit existing health/death/recovery code and propose the smallest shared life-system spine for Lyra AI and players
findings: No shared life-system spine exists yet.
Stock player has take_damage but it immediately respawns instead of tracking health or lifecycle state.
Bachtavious/Lyra player can fire projectiles but does not expose take_damage or health state.
Lyra AI actors can shoot and log combat metrics but do not have health, downed, death, recovery, or revive behavior.
Combat target dummies have isolated health/take_damage/is_alive logic.
Destructibles have separate health/take_damage/destroy logic that should not be migrated first.
Projectile damage signatures are inconsistent: bullet.gd calls take_damage(damage, shooter_id), simple_projectile.gd calls take_damage(damage).

proposal.first_slice: Wire LifeComponent to Lyra AI actors and Bachtavious/player damage entrypoints, then prove life_damaged plus downed/death metrics in lyrasandbox.
